label: Baseline primary exclusive classification
description: Strict mutually exclusive classification without multi-aetiology attribution.

label: Proportional multi-aetiology overlap
description: Proportional attribution: 25% of multi-aetiology and 10% of unclassified cases contain primary aetiology.

label: High overlap and complex multimorbidity
description: High-overlap sensitivity: half of multi-aetiology and 20% of unknown cases involve primary cause.

label: Tertiary referral centre transport scenario
description: Tertiary referral setting: referral enrichment multiplier (1.35x) reflecting tertiary clinic selection.

label: Unselected community cohort transport scenario
description: Community setting: lower specialized ascertainment multiplier (0.75x) in primary care cohorts.

label: Restricted diagnostic capacity scenario
description: Restricted capacity: limited access to sweat chloride, ciliary biopsy or gene panels (0.60x).
